the use of a standardized, reproducible method for measuring endothelial function is essential for the establishment of reference values for endothelial function in a healthy Japanese population and that these reference values can be used to assess endothelial function in patients with cardiovascular disease.

the use of the 2D-3D hybrid method for measuring endothelial function in Japanese adults has good reliability across institutions and that the reference values for endothelial function in healthy Japanese adults are similar to those of other ethnicities.
